items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: But he was a good drummer. So, we’d be on the road. I discovered you don’t go with people you work with.

ctx.x: When was this? J.C. Heard? Tell me about him.

They called him “Swee-dee-dee.” And he was sort of on the pimpy side. But that didn’t hurt me, you know. But he was a good drummer. So, we’d be on the road. I discovered you don’t go with people you work with. You can’t ‘S’ where you eat. And so pretty soon, that broke up.
How long did it take before you learned that?
